description: Work out the units to draw for a prescribed dose from a powder vial and bacteriostatic water. Inputs: vial mg, water mL, the dose (mg or mcg), and the syringe. Returns units, mL, the nearest syringe line and doses per vial. Arithmetic only — the user's own dose, no presets.

dose.description: The prescribed dose, in the unit given by dose_unit

vial_mg.description: Powder in the vial, in mg

name: calc_reconstitute
